---
title: "Sentiment analysis"
output: html_document
---

Use this as a starter file for sentiment analysis.  You should try each of the three lexicons. 
It may make sense to copy this file and use one file per lexicon.
```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


load(here("data/finn_clean.rda"))
```
### im assining values to each word 

```{r}
install.packages("textdata")
afinn <- get_sentiments("afinn")

finn_afinn <- finn_clean |> 
  inner_join(afinn, by = "word")

table(finn_afinn$value) |> prop.table() |> round(2)
```
### mkae a graph to show if the fiin book is generaly happy or sad 
```{r}
ggplot(finn_afinn, aes(x = value)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 11, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Sentiment Distribution in Finn the Wolfhound",
       x = "Sentiment Score (-5 to 5)",
       y = "Frequency")
```
